Key Strengths and Highlights
Here are the key strengths and highlights of Goldfish Swimming School - Livingston:

* **Comprehensive Program Range:** Offers diverse programs including infant lessons (4-35 months), junior classes (3-4 years), glider classes (4-12 years), pro classes (4-12 years), and a swim team [1].
* **Flexible Scheduling:** Provides flexible class times, free make-up lessons, and options for family swim hours, parties, and jump start clinics [1].
* **Small Class Sizes:** Maintains a low student-to-teacher ratio (4:1, 6:1 for baby classes) ensuring personalized attention and enhanced safety [1].
* **Emphasis on Water Safety:** Integrates water safety skills into weekly lessons and offers W.A.T.E.R. safety presentations for kids [1].
* **Positive Learning Environment:** Focuses on building confidence through a play-based curriculum in a warm, 90-degree pool [1].
